## Presentation controls

When viewing the interactive slides:

- use the **left and right arrow keys** or the on-screen controls to move between slides;
- press **F** for full screen;
- press **O** for an overview of all slides;
- press **M** to open the presentation menu;
- interactive R cells may take a moment to initialize the first time.
